I am a junior software engineer and full-stack web developer with a strong foundation in computer science and practical web development. I hold a Master of Computer Applications (MCA) completed in 2026 from Nirmala College, Muvattupuzha (Mahatma Gandhi University) and a Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) from Don Bosco College (Calicut University).

In addition to JavaScript frameworks, I have project experience with Python, Django, MySQL, and OpenCV for computer vision and image processing. I am passionate about backend engineering, full-stack architecture, and creating practical, scalable web applications that solve real-world problems.
